description.zh: 服务是否开启弹性伸缩。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable Auto Scaling for the service.

description.zh: 服务创建账号的 UID
description.en: The UID of the account that created the service.

description.zh: 服务是否开启定时扩缩容。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable scheduled auto scaling for the service.

description.zh: 模糊匹配字段。只支持按服务名字模糊匹配。
description.en: The keyword for a fuzzy search. This parameter supports fuzzy searches by service name only.

description.zh: 私有网关ID。
description.en: The private gateway ID.

description.zh: 服务群组名称，如何获取服务群组名称，请参见[ListServices ](~~412109~~)。
description.en: The name of the service group. To learn how to obtain this name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

description.zh: 是否包含不属于任何工作空间的服务。默认为 true。
description.en: Specifies whether to include services that do not belong to any workspace. The default value is true.

description.zh: 按标签过滤。
description.en: Filters services by label.

description.zh:
排序方式，取值如下：
- desc（默认值）：降序。
- asc：升序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `desc` (default): descending.

- `asc`: ascending.

description.zh: 服务列表的请求页码，默认为1。
description.en: The page number of the results to return. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的服务数量，默认为100。
description.en: The number of services to return per page. The default value is 100.

description.zh: Band成员服务对应的主服务ID。
description.en: The UID of the primary service. This parameter applies to member services in a service group.

description.zh: 配额ID。
description.en: The quota ID.

description.zh: 资源组的自定义名称。
description.en: The custom name of the resource group.

description.zh: 服务是否开启弹性资源池。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable a burstable resource pool for the service.

description.zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见[ListResources](~~412133~~)。
description.en: The ID of the resource group. To learn how to query for this ID, see [ListResources](~~412133~~).

description.zh: 服务所属的资源组名称或ID。
description.en: The name or ID of the service's resource group.

description.zh:
服务所使用的资源类型，取值如下：
- PublicResource
- DedicatedResource
- Lingjun
- SelfManagedLingjun
description.en:
The type of resource the service uses. Valid values:

- PublicResource

- DedicatedResource

- Lingjun

- SelfManagedLingjun

description.zh: 服务角色。
description.en: The service role.

description.zh: 服务名。
description.en: The service name.

description.zh: 服务运行的状态。
description.en: The status of the service.

description.zh:
服务类型，取值如下：
- Async
- Standard
- Queue
- LLM
- RAG
- Serverless
- LLMGatewayService
- Offline Task
- SDCluster
- ScalableJob
- ScalableJobService
- AssistantJob
description.en:
The service type. Valid values:

- Async

- Standard

- Queue

- LLM

- RAG

- Serverless

- LLMGatewayService

- OfflineTask

- SDCluster

- ScalableJob

- ScalableJobService

- AssistantJob

description.zh: 服务UID。
description.en: The service UID.

description.zh: 排序字段。按时间戳类型默认倒序排序。
description.en: The sort field. By default, results are sorted by timestamp in descending order.

description.zh: 是否承接群组流量(仅对群组服务有效)
description.en: Specifies whether the service accepts group traffic. This parameter applies only to services within a service group.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。
description.en: The workspace ID.
